from_quote: with the sole exception of duties on imports and exports
rationale: Mentions in passing "the sole exception of duties on imports and exports" to the States' power to raise revenue, the restriction the next paragraph quotes from this clause; this paragraph does not name or quote the clause itself.

from_quote: the original clause, conferring a general power of taxation upon the Union
rationale: Refers to "the granting clause" and "the original clause, conferring a general power of taxation upon the Union," the clause the preceding paragraph quoted as the first clause of the eighth section.

from_quote: The restraining or prohibitory clause only says, that they shall not, WITHOUT THE CONSENT OF CONGRESS, lay such duties
rationale: Refers to "the restraint laid upon the States in relation to duties on imports and exports" and to "the restraining or prohibitory clause," repeating its words "WITHOUT THE CONSENT OF CONGRESS"; this is the clause quoted in the preceding paragraph.
to_quote: without the Consent of the Congress
